# Synthetic attachment acceptance bundle

`originals/` contains five small, valid originals generated by the standard-library-only `generate.py`. Regenerate into any local directory:

```sh
python3 tests/fixtures/attachments/generate.py /tmp/telegram-attachment-acceptance
```

Generation makes local files only. It does not connect to Telegram, open Codex chats, or start turns. The originals have fixed ZIP timestamps and deterministic bytes. They are synthetic test data, not user documents. The connector must preserve their bytes; document interpretation belongs to Codex and its existing tools.

| Original | Independently specified expected observation |
| --- | --- |
| `note.txt` | Delivery token `copper-otter-73`, line 2 |
| `shapes.png` | Three red squares across the top, two blue circles below on white |
| `checkpoint.pdf` | Two pages; page 2 says `Checkpoint: amber bridge 47` |
| `brief.docx` | Paragraph 2 says `Meeting phrase: silver meadow 29.` |
| `inventory.xlsx` | Sheet `Inventory`; B2 = 7, B3 = 11, B4 = `SUM(B2:B3)` with cached result 18 |

For local orchestration tests a fake Codex adapter may return these findings. Such assertions demonstrate file preservation, association and evidence handling only. They do not demonstrate actual model interpretation. Do not supply this answer table in the eventual Codex prompt.

## Proposed controlled live follow-up, awaiting explicit authorization

Use the **existing approved test Codex chat** and **the same Telegram topic 2 in allowed group -1003989567415, folder 8**. Recheck current membership before each operation. Do not create another chat, read unrelated history or reauthenticate.

After approval, post these five originals as documents (including the image, to preserve original bytes) in that topic, associated with one preparation request. Capture only those new message identities. Submit **one follow-up turn** through the existing task association using this prompt:

> Read every attached original with the applicable existing tools. Return one Markdown result reporting the text delivery token, image shapes/colors/counts, PDF checkpoint with page, Word meeting phrase with paragraph, and spreadsheet quantities plus computed total with sheet/cells. Give per-input interpretation evidence. If any original cannot be read, report a blocker rather than guessing. Preserve originals and put conversions in the work directory.

Verify all five findings against the table above, recorded source identities, preserved hashes, one continued Codex chat, per-input evidence, and delivery of the explanation and generated Markdown document as replies in that same Telegram topic. Reconstruct the application before an additional follow-up reuse check only if separately authorized; the proposed operation is bounded to one turn. A successful local fake-adapter test does not authorize or replace this live acceptance.

## Local original validity checks

The checked-in originals were identified by `file`; PDF text was checked with Poppler and Word text with Pandoc. PDF page 2 and LibreOffice-rendered Word/spreadsheet pages were visually inspected, as was the PNG. The spreadsheet rendered with total 18; a separate LibreOffice recalculation preserved `SUM(B2:B3)`, produced cached value 18, and had no error cells. The usual recalculation helper was unavailable because its optional `openpyxl` dependency is absent; no dependency was installed. These checks validate fixtures, not the production Codex interpretation path. No Telegram or Codex live action was used to prepare them.
